components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:var(--space-3) var(--space-5);border:1px solid var(--btn-primary-border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--btn-primary-bg);color:var(--btn-primary-text);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast) ease,transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-editorial); } .ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary:focus-visible { background:var(--btn-primary-hover-bg);color:var(--btn-primary-hover-text);transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-ghost:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible { outline:var(--focus-outline);outline-offset:var(--focus-outline-offset);box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary,.ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary:active { transform:none;transition:none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-ghost { min-height:44px;padding:var(--space-3) var(--space-5);border:1px solid var(--btn-ghost-border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:transparent;color:var(--btn-ghost-color);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast) ease,border-color var(--motion-fast) ease; } .ds-ghost:hover,.ds-ghost:focus-visible { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel) 60%,transparent);border-color:var(--interactive-border-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-ghost:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible { outline:var(--focus-outline);outline-offset:var(--focus-outline-offset);box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); }

components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex;width:fit-content;align-items:center;padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-4);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--border) 90%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius-pill);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast) ease,transform var(--motion-fast) ease; } .ds-pill:hover,.ds-pill:focus-visible { background:var(--interactive-bg-hover);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 34%,var(--border));transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:var(--focus-outline);outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Trigger

components.css: .ds-nav { position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-block-size:38px;padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-3);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:transparent;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted) 75%,var(--text));font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--motion-fast) ease,background-color var(--motion-fast) ease; } .ds-nav::after { content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline:0.75rem;inset-block-end:0.15rem;block-size:2px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);background:var(--mark);opacity:0; } .ds-nav:hover,.ds-nav:focus-visible,.ds-nav[aria-expanded="true"] { color:var(--text);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 5%,transparent); } .ds-nav[data-section-active="true"] { color:var(--text);font-weight:650; } .ds-nav[data-section-active="true"]::after { opacity:1; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:var(--focus-outline);outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Concern Row
components.description: Heading and explanation paired with a research link; two columns until the narrow phone breakpoint, with no subject label.
components.html:
Count the work the result leaves out.

A service can get faster because its software improved, or because patients, claimants, and staff took on more of the work. The same result can conceal a different cost.

What outcomes hide
components.css: .ds-concern { display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(10rem,0.38fr);gap:var(--space-6);padding-block:var(--space-6);border-top:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--serif); } .ds-concern h3 { margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:var(--text-xl);font-weight:500;line-height:1.3; } .ds-concern p { margin:var(--space-3) 0 0;max-width:65ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-base);line-height:1.65; } .ds-concern a { display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--space-3);padding-block:var(--space-1);color:var(--link);font-size:var(--text-sm);line-height:1.5;text-underline-offset:0.2em;text-decoration-thickness:1px; } .ds-concern a:hover,.ds-concern a:focus-visible { color:var(--link-hover); } .ds-concern a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px; } @media(max-width:900px) { .ds-concern { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(9rem,0.38fr);gap:var(--space-3) var(--space-5); } .ds-concern a { justify-content:start; } } @media(max-width:540px) { .ds-concern { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:var(--space-3); } .ds-concern a { grid-column:1;padding-block:var(--space-2); } }

components.name: Reading Row
components.description: Whole-row link into an argument, a draft requirement, or a working instrument.
components.html:
Read the argument

Theory

Essays on what people absorb, how power stays correctable, and what an institution may ask of the people it governs.
components.css: .ds-reading { display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,0.9fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:var(--space-7);padding-block:var(--space-6);border-top:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--motion-fast) ease; } .ds-reading h3 { margin:0;font-family:"Instrument Serif",var(--serif);font-size:var(--text-home-reading);font-weight:400;line-height:1.1; } .ds-reading span { display:block;margin-top:var(--space-3);color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-xs); } .ds-reading p { margin:0;max-width:65ch;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:var(--text-base);line-height:1.65; } .ds-reading:hover { color:var(--link); } .ds-reading:hover h3 { text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:0.15em; } .ds-reading:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px; } @media(max-width:540px) { .ds-reading { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:var(--space-4); } .ds-reading p { grid-column:1; } .ds-reading svg { grid-column:2;grid-row:1; } }

components.name: Evidence Passage
components.description: Square forest field for a sourced account; local colors remain fixed in both themes.
components.html:
Rulings changed individual debts.
The rule kept running.

From 2016 to 2019, Robodebt’s automated rule raised about 470,000 Australian welfare debts that were not lawfully made.

Read the Robodebt case
components.css: .ds-evidence { --home-proof-bg:#163e35;--home-proof-text:#f5f1e7;--home-proof-muted:#d0dcd4;padding:var(--space-8);background:var(--home-proof-bg);color:var(--home-proof-text); } .ds-evidence h2 { margin:0;font-family:"Instrument Serif",var(--serif);font-size:var(--text-home-section);font-weight:400;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-evidence p { margin-block:var(--space-4);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:var(--text-lg);line-height:1.65; } .ds-evidence a { display:inline-block;padding-block:var(--space-2);color:inherit;font-size:var(--text-sm);text-underline-offset:0.2em;text-decoration-thickness:1px; } .ds-evidence a:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-evidence a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px; } @media(max-width:540px) { .ds-evidence { padding:var(--space-5); } }

components.name: Self-test Choice
components.description: Route-local wrapping native radios with explicit selected colors and visible label focus; sample starts with Yes selected.
components.css: .ds-choices { display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-2); } .ds-choice { position:relative;cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice input { position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice span { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:3.4rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-xs);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600; } .ds-choice input:checked+span { background:var(--btn-primary-bg);color:var(--btn-primary-text); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible+span { outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Warm paper, readable serif text, quiet sans controls, and ruled lists carry the shared system. The homepage adds a large Instrument Serif thesis, a rust italic continuation, and a forest green evidence section. Its hierarchy comes from type, asymmetric columns, and changes in material. Homepage display and evidence styles remain local; shared navigation and current project branding retain their incumbent rules.
keyCharacteristics: Sentence-case serif headings with a lighter homepage display face.
Warm paper, rust marks, sapphire links and shared controls.
Flat sections, fine rules, concern rows without subject labels, and whole-row reading links.
Separate argument, evidence, source links, and limits.
Code-led reading surface; no approved image comp or new raster art.

rules.name: The Scoped Evidence Rule
rules.body: Forest green identifies the homepage evidence passage; keep it local instead of replacing the shared page or navigation palette.

rules.name: The Display Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use the three homepage display sizes through theme variables; retain platform serif prose and shared sans controls.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Preserve flat reading surfaces; reserve the float shadow for floating chrome.

dos: Do retain warm paper, serif reading, shared sans controls, and existing navigation.
Do use shared fluid spacing and type tokens.
Do keep the forest palette and display face local to the homepage.
Do preserve visible focus, semantic headings, reduced-motion behavior, and sources.
Do distinguish evidence, interpretation, drafts, and self-reported results.
donts: Don't reuse the superseded transit signs, station colors, rail, or halt clock on this homepage.
Don't add decorative kickers or eyebrows above homepage headings.
Don't replace ruled reading sequences with nested cards or repeated tiles.
Don't set prose in mono, add gradient text, or introduce hard offset shadows.
Don't turn square homepage sections into a ban on shared rounded controls.
